## Summary

Describe the reader or contributor outcome and the smallest implemented change.

## Change type

- [ ] Source code or tests
- [ ] Project-original editorial content
- [ ] Bibliographic metadata or DOI correction
- [ ] Documentation, workflow, or accessibility improvement
- [ ] Video brief, storyboard, captions, or transcript

## Evidence and rights

List each DOI or official source, the exact source version reviewed, and the applicable license or permission. Identify project-original material. Do not paste publisher text or subscription content.

Describe any AI assistance and the human verification performed. Confirm that no restricted material was supplied to an AI service.

For editorial or media content, confirm that you control the rights and accept the contribution grant in `CONTENT_POLICY.md`.

## Test plan

List the commands and human checks used to verify this change.

- [ ] `npm test -- --run`
- [ ] `npm run test:coverage`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Browser and keyboard path checked when the interface changed

## Public-boundary checklist

- [ ] No API key, token, private hostname, personal path, or other secret is included.
- [ ] No publisher abstract, full paper, subscription corpus text, copied figure, logo, or unapproved mark is included.
- [ ] DOI links are canonical and claims remain within the identified evidence.
- [ ] Accessibility effects—including keyboard use, focus, motion, contrast, captions, and transcripts—were considered.
- [ ] AI assistance is disclosed, or this change used none.
- [ ] The change does not present the prototype as official or endorsed.
